missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Процесс' is the masculine nominative subject of 'занимает'. 'Этот' points to a specific one, and the object phrase shows what it consumes.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Процесс' is the masculine inanimate accusative direct object of 'изучают', matching the nominative. 'Сложный' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of relation. 'Процесса' is the masculine genitive after 'часть', expressing the part-whole link. 'Большого' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Процессу' is the masculine dative governed by 'к', the thing approached. 'Серьёзно' adds the manner of their approach.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after руководить. 'Процессом' is the masculine instrumental governed by 'руководит', which always demands that case. 'Этим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О процессе' uses the masculine prepositional after 'о' to mean discussing the process. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Процессы' is the nominative plural subject of 'идут', which agrees in the plural. 'Все' quantifies them and 'по плану' adds manner.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Процессы' is the masculine inanimate accusative plural object of 'автоматизировал', matching the nominative. 'Многие' quantifies them.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Процессов' is the masculine genitive plural required by 'много'. 'Медленных' agrees in the genitive plural, and the place phrase frames it.
Strategic focus: Prepositional in idiom. 'Процессе' is the prepositional after 'в', in the phrase 'в процессе', meaning during. 'Работы' is the genitive naming the activity.
